question: Should maintainers adopt this plugin-owned interactive login contract while preserving the existing socket identity, or choose the generic `--phone-number` contract from the competing PR?
rationale: The dependency does not force the global identity rename, and the two branches establish different permanent public login contracts; owner intent is required before landing either path.

options.title: Plugin chooser, stable identity
options.body: Keep this branch's plugin-local method chooser and recovery work, revert the global identity rename, and require exact-head device proof.

options.title: Generic CLI phone flag
options.body: Adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85866 only if maintainers want its permanent shared CLI contract and broader compatibility surface.

options.title: Approve identity transition
options.body: Keep the Chrome tuple only as an explicit user-visible product change with fresh-pairing and existing-session upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Plugin chooser, stable identity
recommendation.body: Keep this branch's plugin-local method chooser and recovery work, revert the global identity rename, and require exact-head device proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history ties the existing WhatsApp session behavior to steipete, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the compatibility and contract decision.
